name: ROFIoma popups
author: skll
description: Draws ROFIoma's power menu, your own menus and the keybind cheatsheet in the shell instead of rofi, with HyDE's wlogout hover: the card under the pointer swells, rounds off and bounces. Type to filter, arrows and Enter to pick, and click a keybind to move it to new keys. OmaCraft's ROFIoma page designs them; its scripts open them.
